fdroid:com.example.timenotification.name: Voltascano
fdroid:com.example.timenotification.summary: Voltascano shows battery voltage in the system status bar
fdroid:com.example.timenotification.description:
Voltascano shows Android phone’s real-time battery voltage. The information is always visible in an icon in the status bar and in a notification, even while you use other apps.
Practical uses of monitoring battery voltage:
 🔋 Check battery real health
 Spot signs of battery degradation. Watch for sudden or irregular voltage drops—these are early signs that the battery is degrading.
 🔌 Catch bad chargers or cables
 During charging, voltage should rise smoothly (e.g., 3.7 V → 4.2 V). If it stays flat or jumps irregularly, the cable or adapter is likely defective.
 💀 Avoid unexpected shutdowns
 Monitoring voltage lets you see the exact point where the phone shuts down from low battery. Helping you avoid surprises like the device shutting down at 30% charge.
 📈 Save money on unnecessary battery replacement
 Monitor battery’s voltage to know its true health and decide a battery replacement only when it is actually needed.
 ⚠️ Prolong battery lifespan
 Batteries experience high stress when charged to their maximum voltage, which often happens before the charge indicator shows 100%. By monitoring voltage, you can unplug your phone at the optimal point to reduce stress and extend battery life.
 🔎 Evaluate aftermarket replacement battery capacity
 Quickly know a replacement battery’s quaity. A good battery holds stable voltage under load, while a poor-quality battery drops quickly under use and spikes sharply when charging.
The Voltascano Battery Voltage Display app is a tool for anyone who wants detailed insights into their Android smartphone’s battery health. 
Key Features:
 - User-Friendly Interface: Designed with simplicity in mind, ensuring easy navigation and quick access to vital battery data.
 - Automatic Startup Support: Enables continuous monitoring without requiring manual app relaunches after a reboot.
 - Resource Efficiency: The app operates with minimal RAM usage, ensuring it does not interfere with system performance.
 - No Hidden Processes: Unlike many background apps, it does not run covert services, preventing unnecessary battery drain.
 - Manual Exit Functionality: Allows users to completely exit the app with a single button press, ensuring full control over system resources.
 - Ad-Free Experience: The app is entirely free to use without any intrusive advertisements disrupting the user experience.
 - Wide Compatibility: Works seamlessly on devices running Android 8 and newer versions.
Created by Eugen Barilyuk EB43 https://eb43.github.io

fdroid:com.tokyoxpa3.socksclient.name: 5G Proxy Client
fdroid:com.tokyoxpa3.socksclient.summary: Routes device traffic through a remote SOCKS5 proxy via TUN. No root, TCP/UDP.
fdroid:com.tokyoxpa3.socksclient.description:
Android SOCKS5 TUN tunnel client — routes the device's entire network traffic through a remote SOCKS5 server using a TUN virtual interface. No root required.
Features:
- User-space TCP state machine forwarded via SOCKS5 CONNECT
- UDP / DNS / QUIC relay via SOCKS5 UDP ASSOCIATE (UDP-in-UDP or UDP-in-TCP 0x04)
- Remote DNS (fakedns) with fake IPv4 (198.18.0.0/15) and fake IPv6
- IPv4 + IPv6 dual-stack support
- Per-App routing modes: Global, Allowlist, or Exclusion
- Auto-reconnect with exponential backoff on connection drop
- Live traffic statistics (up/down bytes & session count) in persistent notification
- Custom primary & secondary DNS servers
- Start tunnel on boot
- Quick Settings tile for one-tap tunnel toggle
- Multiple profile management with JSON export/import via clipboard
- Native C (epoll) engine + JNI + Kotlin UI
Privacy notes:
- While the tunnel is up, the proxy server's hostname is re-resolved outside the tunnel (needed to follow DDNS / IP changes without tearing the TUN interface down). That lookup is sent to the DNS servers of the network the tunnel actually runs over. The custom DNS servers above are used only as a fallback when that resolver gives no answer, and the fallback is written to the log.
- With Remote DNS enabled, DNS queries from apps are relayed to the proxy exit instead of being answered locally.
Open source (MIT), reproducible builds.

firefox-addons:884118.name: No PDF Download
firefox-addons:884118.summary: Opens all PDF files directly in the browser.
firefox-addons:884118.description:
While most PDF files can be viewed directly in the browser some PDFs will trigger a "Save as"-dialog or will be downloaded automatically. This addon views all PDF files directly in the browser. You can still save the PDF by pressing CTRL+S (or CMD+S) after viewing them.
Please make sure that the setting under Firefox > Preferences > Applications > PDF is set to "Preview in Firefox" in order for this addon to work.
Some web servers are misconfigured and don't tell the browser that a file is a PDF. In this case the file will still be downloaded even when this addon is active. If you encounter a PDF that is downloaded feel free to send the URL to the support email address so I can check if this it's a bug in the addon or just a server issue.

apple-macos:6786763922.description:
Pixel Finance is a private way to track your whole financial life. Bank accounts, investments, crypto, property and debts all add up to one clear net worth figure, and all of it lives on your iPhone or iPad
There's no sign-up and no server behind the app. We couldn't see your data even if we wanted to, because it never leaves your phone.
TRACK EVERYTHING
• Accounts and cards from any bank, in any currency
• Investments with live prices, and crypto tracked from a public wallet address
• Property, vehicles and valuables, with mortgages and loans counted against them
• Transfers and debt payments that keep both accounts in step
BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
• Log a coffee in three taps
• Budgets that show where the month is heading while you can still do something about it
• Recurring transactions log themselves
• Spending insights: monthly pace, category trends, top merchants
• Proper multi-currency support. Keep GBP, SGD, USD, JPY and more side by side, with the exchange rate saved at the time of each purchase
PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• No account, no cloud copy, no analytics, no ads, no trackers
• Face ID lock, plus a privacy shield in the app switcher
• Stealth mode hides every amount with one tap
• Export everything to CSV whenever you like. It's your data
PIXEL FINANCE PRO (optional subscription)
• Import bank and card statements as PDFs, read entirely on your device
• Scan paper receipts straight into transactions. Photos stay on your phone
• Sync between devices through a cloud folder you own (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, or your own server), end-to-end encrypted before anything is uploaded. We never see your folder or your key
• Unlimited accounts and budgets. The free version includes 10 of each
The only things the app ever fetches are public reference data like exchange rates, market prices and logos. Your ledger stays with you.
Terms of Use: https://pixelfinance.org/terms
Privacy Policy: https://pixelfinance.org/privacy
Questions? hello@pixelfinance.org
